emergingThreats.action.confirm: Confirm first: your assets may be affected but the version is not certain. Check the version, then patch or mark not affected.
emergingThreats.action.patch_now: Patch now: this is known to be exploited and your assets are confirmed affected.
emergingThreats.action.patch_within_sla: Patch within your SLA: it is not known to be exploited yet.
emergingThreats.actions.outOfScopeHint: This alert has assets outside your scope, so you cannot mark it not affected. Ask someone with wider access.
emergingThreats.description: New or newly exploited vulnerabilities that match software your assets run, ranked by how likely they are to hurt you now.
emergingThreats.detail.scoreHint: Out of 100. Each part below adds to the total; the confidence multiplier lowers it when the match is uncertain.
emergingThreats.empty.description: Nothing matches these filters. New alerts appear when a published or newly exploited vulnerability matches software your assets run.
emergingThreats.empty.title: No emerging threats
emergingThreats.levelHint.immediate: Alerts you as soon as it is found
emergingThreats.notAffected.description: This hides the alert and stops messages about it for 180 days. A stronger match, or the vulnerability being added to the known-exploited list, reopens it.
emergingThreats.notAffected.reasons.comp: A compensating control is in place
emergingThreats.notAffected.reasons.feat: The affected feature is not used
emergingThreats.notAffected.reasons.vers: The versions we run are not affected
emergingThreats.notAffected.reasons.wron: The match is the wrong product
emergingThreats.notAffected.title: Mark {vulnId} not affected
emergingThreats.settings.alertsHelp: Scores run from 0 to 100. A threat at or above the immediate threshold alerts at once; one at or above the digest threshold goes in the daily digest; the rest are only listed.
emergingThreats.settings.assetNamesHelp: Off by default. When on, an external message names at most 5 assets.
emergingThreats.settings.description: When new or newly exploited vulnerabilities alert you, and how.
emergingThreats.settings.enabledHelp: Off: no alerts are created and no messages are sent.
emergingThreats.settings.err.digestBelow: The digest threshold must be below the immediate threshold.
emergingThreats.settings.err.digestThres: Enter a whole number from 20 to 60.
emergingThreats.settings.err.hour: Enter a whole hour from 0 to 23.
emergingThreats.settings.err.immediateTh: Enter a whole number from 60 to 90.
emergingThreats.settings.err.quietOverri: Enter a whole number from 70 to 100.
emergingThreats.settings.hourHint: Hours are read in the organization time zone ({timezone}).
emergingThreats.settings.includePossible: Include possible matches in immediate alerts
Off: an immediate alert needs a confirmed affected asset. On: a match where the version is unknown can also alert at once.
emergingThreats.settings.messagesHelp: What messages sent outside the console may say.
emergingThreats.settings.noPermission: Owners and admins change emerging-threat settings.
emergingThreats.settings.quietHelp: Hold messages during these hours. A threat at or above the override score still alerts.
emergingThreats.settings.quietOverrideHe: {min} to {max}. Threats at or above this score alert even in quiet hours.
emergingThreats.settings.title: Emerging threats

emergingThreats.task.description: One task with {n} open findings of this alert.
